segments.text:
I.
FOuntain of Being, Source of Good!
At whoſe Almighty Breath
The Creature proves our Bane or Food,
Diſpenſing Life or Death:

II.
Thee we addreſs with humble Fear,
Vouchſafe thy Gifts to crown;
Father of All, thy Children hear,
And ſend a Bleſſing down.

III.
O may our Souls for ever pine
Thy Grace to taſte and ſee;
Athirſt for Righteouſneſs Divine,
And hungry after Thee!

IV.
For this we lift our longing Eyes,
We wait the gracious Word;
Speak—and our Hearts from Earth ſhall riſe,
And feed upon the Lord.
